ORDINANCE FER |lo, 2024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing B3-2
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map 1-J in the area bounded
by:

West Chicago Avenue; North Central Park Avenue; a line 156 feet south of and parallel
to West Chicago Avenue; the alley next west of and parallel to North Central Park
Avenue; a line 78.30 feet south of and parallel to West Chicago Avenue; and North
Monticello Avenue,

to those of the B3-3 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Address: 3601-3625 W. Chicago Avenue, 751-757 N. Monticello Ave., 740-756 N. Central Park
Ave., Chicago, Illinois
